overview.en:
Build forms and analyze submissions through Tally’s official MCP server (Beta).

Review form content and collected responses before preparing a new questionnaire or revision. Keep the target audience and response scope clear.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
通过 Tally 官方 MCP 服务构建表单并分析提交记录（Beta）。

准备新问卷或修改前，先查看表单内容与已收集回答，明确目标受众和回答范围。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。

starterPrompts.en: Summarize the responses to this form and highlight recurring themes.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 总结这份表单的回答，标出反复出现的主题。

starterPrompts.en: Review this questionnaire and suggest clearer questions.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 检查这份问卷，建议更清晰的问题表述。

starterPrompts.en: Prepare a draft form for this research goal.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 为这个研究目标准备表单草稿。

descriptions.en: Use Tally in Ghast. Build forms and analyze submissions through Tally’s official MCP server (Beta). 通过 Tally 官方 MCP 服务构建表单并分析提交记录（Beta）。
